job.title: Senior Enterprise Security Engineer
job.pay_full: $196,750 – $243,290 a year starting base pay (San Mateo, CA headquarters), plus eligibility for equity compensation and benefits

details.about: Every day, tens of millions of people use Roblox to explore, create, play, learn and connect in 3D immersive experiences built by its global community of developers and creators. As a Senior Enterprise Security Engineer you help carry out Roblox's Enterprise Security Strategy, designing, deploying and managing security solutions that protect its corporate infrastructure and keep operations secure and compliant. You work closely with Corporate Engineering and Trust & Safety, partner across the Information Security organization, and report to the Senior Manager of Enterprise Security Engineering.
duties: Evaluate and implement security technologies and vendor solutions against enterprise security requirements, compliance standards and risk strategy
Lead initiatives across Endpoint Security, SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), Identity & Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance and third-party/vendor risk management
Work with IT, engineering, DevOps and business stakeholders to build security tools, policies and processes into enterprise systems so they are secure by design
Design and build automation scripts and tools that streamline security workflows, collect metrics and enforce security policies at scale
needs: Familiarity with identity and access management, authentication and authorization, endpoint management, network security controls and SaaS security posture management
Strong understanding of zero trust architecture, threat modeling, security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and corporate security best practices
Experience writing and maintaining scripts in at least one language such as SQL or Python
Collaborative, strategic about build-versus-buy decisions and comfortable with ambiguity
nice: Expertise in GWS, OSQuery, Okta and AWS
details.benefits: Starting base pay $196,750 – $243,290 a year for roles based at the San Mateo, CA headquarters; actual pay depends on background, training, experience, location, business needs and market demand. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and benefits.
notes: Office-based roles are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday
Roblox may not be able to employ candidates whose US work authorization relates to certain visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship, at this time
Reasonable accommodations are available during recruiting for qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs
